name: Global temperature
summary: Global temperature 1.98°C above pre-industrial on 30 Oct, a record for the date
state: ERA5 data for 30 Oct put global surface air temperature about 1.98°C above pre-industrial levels, a record for the calendar date and well past the 1.6°C Alert line (Climate Reanalyzer). The strong El Niño is adding to long-term warming.
for_you: Record warmth raises the odds of heat extremes and heavy rain in many regions; follow national weather services for warnings.
why: Global temperature is the master climate variable; each tenth of a degree raises extreme-weather risk.
drivers: Greenhouse gases, El Niño/La Niña, aerosols, solar cycle.

rubric.alert: > +1.6°C, or a record high for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Daily global anomaly < +1.3°C above pre-industrial (ERA5 vs 1991–2020 + 0.88°C).
